summary: Implemented an isolated durable contention-start barrier candidate that prevents a single early worker from consuming a live race fixture before quorum. Distinct /wc workers register append-only no-authority entrant receipts; RELEASE requires distinct-worker quorum before deadline and grants no execution authority; only after release do contenders race the normal deterministic portfolio pin. Timeout produces no pin and returns the worker to allocation. The exact committed test source passes 2-worker and 5-worker release/race cases, duplicate-registration dedupe, exactly-one pin winner, loser collision/re-entry and timeout behavior. A bounded real-GitHub rendezvous canary was materialized; the candidate is not promoted into binding protocols by this return.
